question:
Select the most appropriate homophone to fill in the blank.

Arun knows perfectly well how to mix the food items with __________.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Sauce" **refers to a liquid or semi-liquid substance served with food to add moistness and flavor. (चटनी)

 
 
• **Example: **He added a spicy** sauce **to his pasta to enhance its flavor.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the correct homophone to fill in the blank is **'sauce'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Source **(स्रोत): The origin or starting point of something.

 
 
• **Example:** The source of the information was highly reliable.
 
 
 
• **Saws **(आरी ): Tools used for cutting wood or other materials.
 
 
• **Example: **He used saws to cut the wooden planks for the project.
 
 
 
• **Sause** (गलत वर्तनी): Incorrect spelling, not a valid word.
 
 
• **Example:** There is no valid example as this is a misspelling of 'sauce'.
